candidate_revisions.kind: explicit source-pinned development candidates; not General install evidence

source_access: Private QUBOBenchmarks harness. This shareable aggregate permits checking the published paired arithmetic; it does not claim public reproduction of private producer code.

conclusions.root_integration: keep default off; capacity gains and no-benefit losses are fixture-specific
conclusions.full_verification_export: explicit consumer boundary; defer automatic use on every hot update
conclusions.optional_detailed_reporting: opt-in; report its complete allocation/time cost, no automatic adoption
conclusions.performance_acceptance: bounded evidence for the separately recorded release/adoption decision

phase_timing_limit: Evidence phases have no discarded per-boundary warmup and can include first-call JIT. They are inclusive observations, not steady-state phase costs. Hot cycles and complete workflows have separate warmups.
uncertainty: Five paired differences and observed range; no population confidence claim or universal speed ratio. Break-even estimates use sample-average cycle costs, not measured first-crossover positions.
